basic_info.description: Welcome to 730 Florida St #8, a stunning live/work loft condo in one of San Francisco's most vibrant and evolving neighborhoods Inner Mission. Nestled just steps from the lively 20th Street corridor, this rear-facing 1-bedroom, 2-bathroom, two-level loft offers the perfect blend of urban energy and private retreat.  Step inside to soaring ceilings, floor-to-ceiling windows, and an expansive open-concept living space designed for modern comfort. The gas fireplace and hardwood floors add warmth and character, while the spacious private patio creates a rare outdoor escape in the city. The updated kitchen and in-unit washer/dryer provide everyday convenience, and one-car parking is included.  With a 97 Walk Score & 99 Bike Score, you're moments from Gus' Market, Sightglass Coffee, Flour + Water, Trick Dog, Mission Cliffs, and more.  Experience the best of city living with all the comforts of home. Don't miss your chance to own a piece of the Inner Mission's dynamic future! Some photos include virtual staging.
